comment: Terraform roots that may run on local state, each with the reason it never holds shared or long-lived state. scripts/check-terraform-roots.py fails CI for any root that is neither listed here nor ships backend.tf.example (honua-iac#320). Adding a root here is a reviewed decision: a root applied in the Honua account must ship backend.tf.example instead.
